summary: Goldgroup Mining Inc., a Canadian foreign private issuer, furnished a Form 6-K on September 4, 2026, comprising interim financial statements, MD&A, certificates, and a business acquisition report dated August 24-25, 2026, related to an asset acquisition. The registrant filed under cover of Form 6-K (SEC File No. 001-43406). The interim financials show liabilities held for sale and a deposit received, indicating divestiture activity, but no deal terms, pricing, or board recommendation are disclosed. This filing is a routine periodic report that also references a prior acquisition, so it does not on its own constitute a special situation. What to watch: subsequent material definitive agreements or a Form 40-F/20-F detailing terms.
